description: Mudi (GL-E750) portable 4G LTE router — QCA9533 2.4GHz + QCA9887 5GHz, battery powered

serial_console.note: Kernel console is ttyS0 at 115200 8N1; /etc/inittab drives it with ::askconsole: (/usr/libexec/login.sh). On the unit measured, /proc/consoles reported 'ttyS0 -W- (EC a)' (write-only) and a marker transmitted into the port never arrived at the unit, while the unit's own output was byte-clean — so treat output capture as reliable and input as unproven until loopback-tested on your own wiring. See AGENTS.md 'Serial Wiring: Verify Before Connecting'.

sysupgrade.description: SSH sysupgrade from an existing OpenWrt install (the only method documented for this model so far)

warnings: 5 GHz QCA9887 may fail to probe entirely on some units: 'failed to read calibration data from EEPROM: -22', 'could not probe fw (-22)'. When it fails there is NO phy0 and no 5 GHz interface at all — the unit presents a single radio (2.4GHz ath9k). Do not assume two radios or a working 5 GHz radio.

Do not 'fix' the 5 GHz failure by dropping calibration files into /lib/firmware/ath10k/QCA9887/hw1.0/. On the unit measured, installing a pre-cal-*/cal-* file did not revive the radio and instead ADDED a second failure: 'failed to get board id: -122' (the target refuses the board-id query that a pre-cal file selects). Removing the files removes the -122 and restores the original -22. See felixfelix-bot/e750-repair docs/EVIDENCE.md section 3.
No recovery/bootloader flash method (U-Boot HTTP/TFTP) has been verified on this model. Do not assume one exists; treat a failed flash as requiring serial console access.
The 2.4GHz radio is commonly configured as a CLIENT (STA) uplink on this model, not an AP — check 'iw dev' for type before assuming a serving AP.
notes: Bench observations, 2026-10-25, on OpenWrt 25.12.5 r33051-f5dae5ece4, kernel 6.12.94 (ath79/nand, mips_24kc). Identity: /tmp/sysinfo/board_name = glinet,gl-e750; /tmp/sysinfo/model = GL.iNet GL-E750; /etc/board.json model.id = glinet,gl-e750. Partition table as reported by /proc/mtd: mtd0 u-boot 0x00040000, mtd1 u-boot-env 0x00010000, mtd2 art 0x00010000, mtd3 kernel 0x00400000, mtd4 reserved 0x00ba0000, mtd5 ubi 0x08000000 (erasesize 0x00020000). Radio state on the measured unit: only phy1 present (ath9k, 2.4GHz, ch11), 5GHz QCA9887 never probed. NO flash method was exercised on this model — tested_hardware is deliberately empty rather than claiming an untested sysupgrade.
